canonical_project: Nxtra by Airtel Mumbai-II Chandivali hyperscale campus
notes: Nxtra's Mumbai hyperscale campus at Chandivali Farm Road, Andheri East (Boomerang area), Mumbai Suburban; announced 2020 as a new Maharashtra campus, reported as a ~90 MW hyperscale data centre under construction, with aggregators listing about 58 MW power on 600,000 sq ft; Mumbai hosts Nxtra's largest western cluster.
